description: This file implements disk cache backend creation and management, including classes for cache creation, file operations, and cache result handling, primarily for Chromium's networking component.

classes.name: CacheCreator
classes.description: Manages creation and initialization of disk cache backends, handling platform-specific logic, cleanup, and retries.

classes.name: TrivialFileEnumerator
classes.description: Provides file enumeration over a directory for trivial file operations.

classes.name: UnboundTrivialFileOperations
classes.description: Factory for binding trivial file operations.

classes.name: BackendResult
classes.description: Represents the result of backend creation, including success or error states.

classes.name: EntryResult
classes.description: Represents the result of cache entry operations, including success, error, or opened/created states.

classes.name: TrivialFileOperations
classes.description: Implements basic file operations such as create, delete, replace, and enumerate files.

classes.name: TrivialFileOperationsFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of TrivialFileOperations.

methods.name: CreateCacheBackendImpl
methods.description: Creates a cache backend based on type, platform, and configuration.

methods.name: CreateCacheBackend
methods.description: Entry point for creating cache backend with default parameters.

methods.name: FlushCacheThreadForTesting
methods.description: Flushes cache threads synchronously for testing.

methods.name: FlushCacheThreadAsynchronouslyForTesting
methods.description: Flushes cache threads asynchronously for testing.
